harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS share /srv/nfs/shared on node1 exported to node2, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, with matching dataops (UID/GID 4500) identity on both hosts and dataops:dataops ownership, mode 2770. Verified cross-node write consistency, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 then node2, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of NFS service, mount, and data on each.
actions_performed: Inspected both nodes (RHEL 9.8, no prior nfs-utils/dataops)
Created group+user dataops with UID=GID=4500 on node1 and node2
Installed nfs-utils on both nodes via dnf
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, chown dataops:dataops, chmod 2770
Configured /etc/exports.d/shared.exports restricting export to node2's IP with root_squash, ran exportfs -ra
Enabled and started nfs-server and rpcbind on node1
Opened firewalld services nfs, rpc-bind, mountd on node1 and reloaded
Created /mnt/shared on node2, added fstab entry, mounted NFS share
Verified showmount from node2 and bidirectional file creation with consistent dataops:dataops ownership
Captured pre-restart boot_id/service/data baseline on both nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id and full NFS service/export/data recovery
Verified node2's existing mount survived node1's restart with a successful write
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id and automatic fstab remount plus data integrity and new write
Cleaned up all test files from the shared directory

evidence.requirement: dataops UID/GID 4500 created on both nodes
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) on node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: nfs-utils installed on both nodes
evidence.summary: dnf install completed, rpm -q confirms nfs-utils-2.5.4-42.el9_8 on both nodes

evidence.requirement: /srv/nfs/shared created with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770 on node1
evidence.summary: ls -ld shows drwxrws--- dataops dataops

evidence.requirement: NFS export configured and service active on node1
evidence.summary: exportfs -v shows /srv/nfs/shared exported to node2 IP; nfs-server and rpcbind active

evidence.requirement: firewall opened for NFS on node1
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd added nfs/rpc-bind/mountd services; showmount from node2 subsequently succeeded

evidence.requirement: NFS mounted at /mnt/shared on node2
evidence.summary: mount output shows node1 export mounted nfs4 at /mnt/shared, fstab entry added for persistence

evidence.requirement: consistent dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770 across both nodes, cross-node write test
evidence.summary: Files created by dataops on node2 appear as dataops:dataops on node1 and vice versa; directory mode 2770 confirmed on both sides

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart baseline
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f1afbc7f..., nfs-server/rpcbind active, export present, data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 pre-restart baseline
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 98aa35f5..., mount active, dataops identity confirmed

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and connectivity loss
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged; subsequent probes timed out confirming node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Node reachable again; boot_id changed to e9df296b..., uptime reset to ~5.7s, nfs-server/rpcbind active, export and data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mount survives node1 restart
evidence.summary: Post node1-restart write from node2 as dataops succeeded and listed correctly

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and connectivity loss
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged; subsequent probes timed out/reset confirming node went down

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Node reachable again; boot_id changed to 00ab8f4a..., uptime reset to ~6.4s, fstab auto-remounted NFS share, prior data intact, new dataops write succeeded

evidence.requirement: final cleanup and state verification
evidence.summary: Test files removed, /srv/nfs/shared confirmed empty with correct ownership/mode dataops:dataops 2770

Verified cross-node write consistency, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of node1 then node2, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of NFS service, mount, and data on each.
